Definition: a Jishvite (collectively) or descendants of Jishvi
BiblicalUsage: Yishvîy means a Jishvite (collectively) or descendants of Jishvi. In Numbers 26:44 we read, "Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui..."
TheologicalSignificance: Yishviy is a Jishvite (collectively) or descendants of Jishvi, and my conviction is that even the rarest words in the Bible were put there on purpose.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
